- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated the highest revenue TW at £3,429.15, followed by WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £3,266.50.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led unit sales TW with 1,198 units, while WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS achieved 1,104 units.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER topped order counts TW with 46 orders, ahead of SPOTTY BUNTING with 45 orders.
- POLKADOT PEN showed exceptional WoW revenue growth of 18,121.5%, significantly outperforming other products.
- RED HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved WoW revenue growth of 1,041.8%, demonstrating strong week-on-week momentum.
- BROCADE RING PURSE delivered the strongest YoY revenue performance at 10,158.9% growth compared to the same week last year.
- CAMOUFLAGE DESIGN TEDDY grew 1,239.9% YoY in revenue, while NO SINGING METAL SIGN increased 559.7% YoY.
- PARTY BUNTING generated £1,795.82 revenue TW with 41 orders, establishing itself as a consistent performer in the top revenue products.
